title: Bayer letters with Third Reich generals about camp trials

tellings.quote: There's even uh letters back and forth between Bayer and some of the generals of the Third Reich.

plain: There are letters, says Brigham Buhler, a guest talking about the drug industry's dark past, that went back and forth between the German drug company Bayer and generals of the Third Reich, the Nazi state, about trials carried out in the camps. Buhler mentions the letters in passing as something he has been told about, and does not describe what they say. If true, it would tie a major drug maker directly to Nazi human experiments.
